messages:
alex: Hey — alert: validator v2.4.1 rejects spiked on 'payments-adapter' toolcall, routing to degen and causing weird billing. Anyone monitoring?

maya: yep saw it at 03:12 UTC. reject rate ~2.3% over last 15m. samples point to missing response.details.amount

sam: paste one sanitized sample pls

alex: ```json
{"tool": "payments-adapter", "response": {"status": "ok", "details": {}}}
```
validator expected response.details.amount numeric

jules: we toggled stricter enum+nullable checks in the canary earlier. maybe payments-adapter traffic slipped into canary due to routing overlap

maya: canary config says payments-adapter excluded, but ops-bot shows canary-deploy at 03:05 (canary-374)

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered canary-deploy for validator-service at 2025-03-20T03:05:12Z - id: canary-374

sam: console currently surfaces reject-count but not per-route sampled link. alert should include sample link + reason. UX asked for inline quick triage.

jules: proposal: add telemetry tags (route_id, validator_version, reason), capture redacted sample, and render 'Recent Rejects' card on route details with one-click create ticket

alex: also quota/billing misattribution: rejects sometimes counted as 'success' route so customers get billed incorrectly. need a 'validation_rejected' metric dimension

maya: agree. will change sampling pipeline to attach route_id and validation_reason. also ensure audit log stores validator version

sam: i'll add console panel showing sampled rejects + toggle to soft-fail for 48h per-route. can add redaction and sample cap. ETA tomorrow EOD

jules: design asks @lara for a small inline indicator 'validator: strict (canary 2%)' on route config, click -> samples

lara: can do. will mock today

maya: immediate mitigation: i flipped canary gate for payments-adapter at 03:40. reject rate returned to baseline. created INF-2213 assigned to maya/sam

ops-bot: ticket INF-2213 created: 'validator rejects -> telemetry + console link' assigned maya,sam

alex: thanks. follow-up: add unit tests for validator schema mismatch to prevent rollout surprises

sam: adding tests to canary pipeline + a deploy step to ensure route exclusion honored

jules: cool. we'll track in INF-2213 and sync in tomorrow standup

maya: closing loop here.
